text:
Maya: quick FYI — data spike in embed telemetry this morning. we’re seeing disproportionate sampling for oversize requests (dim>1024) which is blowing up our event volume. wondering if we should adjust the dim-sampler weight or move to per-tenant sampling.
Chris: saw that — +280% events for the oversized-path between 03:00-04:15 UTC. most came from 4 tenants.
Devon: can you paste the raw query/alert? curious if it’s the preflight path or post-splitter tagging.
Maya: alert: `sum(events) by (route,tenant,reason) where event_type=\"embed:oversize_sample\"` — 4 tenants show 90% of the increase.
Chris: looks like preflight is flagging them, sampler tag added in middleware before splitter. so sampler amplifies when clients send mixed dims frequently.
Sara: UX thought — if we expose "telemetry-sampling" per-tenant in Console (toggle + rate slider) we can dial down noisy tenants without global changes. low-risk rollout.
Devon: implementation note: we already respect `X-Embed-Sample-Rate` header for experiments. could add tenant override in routing policy (tenant meta -> sample_rate) that overrides header when present. patch is ~40 LOC.
Maya: +1. also need to avoid cardinality explosion in traces/metrics. proposal: keep event dimensions limited to route, tenant, sample_bucket; drop raw dim vector size from event labels.
Chris: agree on reducing labels. but ops still needs histogram of dims to detect regressions. propose: keep coarse buckets (<=64, 65-256, 257-1024, >1024) in metrics, not as high-card labels.
Devon: sample config sketch (pseudo):
```
route: /v1/embeddings
sampling:
  default: 0.05
  tenant_overrides:
    tenant_kk: 0.005
  dim_buckets:
    - max: 64
    - max: 256
    - max: 1024
    - max: inf
```
Sara: for Console UI, we can show current sampling effective rate (header vs tenant override) and an "apply to noisy tenants" button that suggests a new rate based on recent event ratio. simple CTA.
Maya: rollout plan: canary tenant override for 1 tenant, monitor event volume and error/latency impact for 24h, then scale. need a telemetry flag to record if override used.
IngressBot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for tenant_kk at 2024-11-03T09:12:30Z — config applied to edge-3.
Chris: after canary, let's store a 7-day retention metric for sampled vs unsampled events so we can tune the default. also add an alert if sampled events > 2000/s sustained.
Devon: I’ll open a PR for middleware change + runtime config merge. will include the dim-bucket histogram metric and ensure label cardinality stays low.
Sara: I’ll prototype Console toggle + suggestion CTA — mockup by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: action items: Devon PR, Chris alert, Sara UI mock, and ops to watch canary. tagging @Devon @Chris @Sara. thanks :thumbsup:
Chris: noted. I’ll also add a short FAQ for customers explaining "why sampling changed" so support doesn't get swamped.
Maya: perfect. we’ll reconvene after 24h canary.
IngressBot: monitoring-bot: alert cleared for embed-ingest-rate spike at 2024-11-03T10:35:12Z. sample events back to expected after tenant override.
Maya: great, closing loop here. if anyone wants to tweak bucket boundaries, comment on the PR.
